faq.q: Welche Spiele eignen sich gut für ältere Erwachsene?
faq.a: Gute Spiele sind einfach, vertraut und ohne Druck: große Bilder zum Zuordnen, Sortieren, leichte Puzzles, das Ergänzen bekannter Sprichwörter, Ausmalen, Bilder-Bingo und Gesprächskarten. Sie passen für viele ältere Erwachsene, auch für Menschen, die mit Demenz leben. Die beste Wahl ist das Spiel, das der Person heute Freude macht. Vermeiden Sie Timer, Punkte und alles, was sich wie ein Test anfühlt.
E. Omo kamwitwit me pepa me e bita mwitwit ean Creative Activities eko amwien, eko akaun, sign-up me eko daunlod. Kamwitwit nio re mwitwit ean browser ean fon, tablet me kombiuta.

faq.q: E kamwitwit in tutuo bita e iuwin dementia?
faq.a: Es ist nicht belegt, dass ein Spiel Demenz verhindert, und Creative Activities behauptet nicht, etwas zu behandeln oder zu verhindern. Unsere Spiele dienen dem Vergnügen und der gemeinsamen Zeit, und keine Aktivitätsseite macht gesundheitsbezogene Versprechen.

faq.q: E kamwitwit nio e omo re engame me bita Alzheimer's?
faq.a: E. Bita gogoro Alzheimer's e bita me e gbil in oron me dementia, ma kamwitwit nio me aiyuin me bita: pija egbil me e pwer, mwaid me eko mwait, ma eko me bita aea tutuo me ba ouga. Etokon, ikurin, ma kaeodun dorer ngago erowa e iuwin ean tutuo me etam oiya erowa, ma eko me bo me e rita.

faq.q: E engame me bita dementia me etam uwan e mwitwit nio?
faq.a: Mwait ibum, e, me engame epwipwi ean arere. Omo kamwitwit Find the same me pija aro, Picture pairs me tile eangit, pepa in kala, me arongeiy an tutuo. Ouga me mwamwit, aea an ouga, ma kaeodun ngago e meta me e da.

faq.q: E dorer ngago an ngaga e kowen?
faq.a: Bita sait eko akaun me eko ad. Anga aea Google Analytics me e aen bita pej ngago engame e rita. Pija ngago ekoe ituga me Photo pairs e ainganiyen re browser engame ma eko bita upload.

about.lede: Creative Activities makes calm, adult activities that two people can enjoy side by side, whether one is caring for the other or they simply want to spend time together.
about.bodyHtml:
Who it is for

Anyone caring for someone: a parent, a grandparent, a child, a partner, a friend, or a person living with dementia. Families, older adults and activity staff can all use the same pages.

What we believe

The point of an activity is the moment itself: a conversation, a smile, the satisfaction of putting two pictures together, or simply sitting close. It is not to measure anyone, push them further or prove anything.

Many brain-training apps are designed around speed, scores, streaks and levels. For someone who is tired, unwell or living with dementia, that can feel like an exam they cannot pass. We designed the opposite, and we hold ourselves to these rules:

  • Nothing to fail. No clock, score, move counter, lives, streaks, confetti or countdowns, on any screen.
  • Recognition over recall. Pictures stay showing by default. Prompts invite conversation and never quiz names or memories.
  • Big, plain and steady. Large text and pictures, high contrast, and controls that stay in the same place.
  • Adult dignity. Real-world pictures and plain, warm words. No cartoons, sing-song praise or emoji rewards.
  • An easy way out. “Done for now” is always visible. Stopping halfway is a good outcome.
  • Private by default. No accounts or ads. Photos you choose stay on your device.

What we do not claim

Our games and activities are for enjoyment and connection. They do not diagnose, test, measure, treat, slow or prevent dementia or Alzheimer’s disease, and no one should choose them for that reason. When we write about health research, we say plainly where the evidence is weak, and we never connect it to our own activities.

Who we are

Creative Activities is a small independent team. We are not clinicians. Our guides are written from published guidance by organizations such as the National Institute on Aging and the Alzheimer’s Association, and every guide lists its sources. Read how we write and check our pages.

Tell us what would help

We would love to hear what works for you and what does not, especially from people living with dementia, family caregivers and activity staff. Email {email}.

editorial.title: Keit A Dorer me Aea Am Peij
editorial.description: Ekakai ñ Creative Activities ekaiu, ekakai, ekaiu, ma ekaiu ñ activity ma health page, ma ekakai ña ekaiu ñ ekaiu ñ ekaiu.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

faq.title: Kiudoita me Duwom
faq.seoTitle: Ekakai ma Ekaiu ñ Creative Activities
faq.description: Ekaiu ñ ekakai ñ ekakai ñ game ma activity: ekakai ñ ekaiu, ekaiu ñ ekaiu, group ma ekaiu ñ later-stage, health ma privacy.
faq.lede: Duwom me e eti dogin kiudoita me amen kakarau e kiudoita.

items.q: What are the best games for older adults?
items.a: Katenten me omo e eti, ata me eab tsimine pressure, me e omo nan engame e mwiya ngago nane. Pija matching me pija e aea, sorting, jigsaws me e eti, dorer me ata bita, coloring me pija bingo e omo dogin engame me eto. Eab aea timer, score me nan e aea exam.

items.q: E kor bwo katenten e free me eab kaniwon?
items.a: Ehe. Akani kakuri ma bwiida me pwerint e dorer (free), eke akaun, eke sain-ap, daunrot me eke katangain.

items.q: Erangan eke skoar, reber, me taima?
items.a: Bita omo me skoar ogona eouweiy bita makur animwen ngeni eketam, me ogona aroweniy me kakarur. Ango anani tsimine ian animwen ma ao karowa, eno eke tsimine me feir me ogona tubwi ian nene ao.

items.q: Aiet masin me animwen ngeni bita?
items.a: Nene terepon, tablet me komputa me tsimine web browser gouw. Bita tablet ian stand ean thebur e animwen bwe arow engame ogona kakuri iturin. Bita laptop me komet ngeni TV e animwen ngeni gurup.

items.q: Ango ogona kakuri ngeni pija ian anga nuwawin?
items.a: Ehe. Photo pairs e eouweiy 2 ngeni 6 pija me om reiet ngeni kakuri me matching. Akani pija e mendet ian om browser me eab upload me seif.

items.q: Aiet ao me makur ogona totow?
items.a: Ngaian 10 ngeni 20 minit e bwo, me nene 2 minit e animwen. Taramwi amen om karameie ean magum me rur me tubwi ngago e animwen. Eke tsimine bita ao me bwiida.

items.q: Ite me re eab rogen makur?
items.a: Kakarameie bita 'eab', me anian teke ian bita ao eke tsimine me gouw. Eab rogen ogona metu tsin magum, ngudu, meturur me eab rogen. Taraw bita anan guide ean aiet makur ngago re ouga 'eab'.

items.q: Aiet makur me animwen ngeni later-stage dementia?
items.a: Animwen ma matani: deretoi musik animwen, kakarameie be ngeni lotion, taraw pija karowa, dobe berangket marur, teki iturin mwimwi, me kakuri pija ewewe ngeni amen iturin. Bita guide ian later-stage e tsimine bwo iedia.

items.q: E tsimine makur ngeni gurup ian mwengo me kakarameie (care home)?
items.a: Ehe. Picture bingo e tsimine kadi me pwerint me caller ian skrin, me Finish the saying ma Conversation cards e animwen ngago ango dorer ebio. Bita anan guide ngeni care home e dorer ean ranga gurup, teki me aroweniy makur.

items.q: Kakuri ogona tubwi me eouweiy dementia me meteketek?
items.a: Eke tsimine kakuri me tsimodu bwe e tubwi dementia, me anan kakuri eab ouga. Makur ian ut ian gurup e tsimodu ian risits bwe ogona kowat amen etokatok me mild ngeni moderate dementia, ma e ewewe me kakuri bwe e tubwi mwiyan. Ango anani kakuri bwe animwen me karowa.

Eab tsimine ropwit. Risits e aroweniy 14 metani emaron ma rogen mour ngeni dementia, ngeni eab dereto, daro ebio, eab makur ma eko engame iturin. Taramwi akani ogona kakarameie ngeni eke engame, ma bwo engame me makur animwen me ouga dementia. Eab tsimine amen eatan.

items.q: Eanimwen intermittent fasting ngeni emaron an ut?
items.a: Aroweniy ean engame e eke bwo, me bwo risits e ian menin. Fasting ogona eouweiy emaron ngeni rodu, ian anani rogen medisene ean diabetes me ibeibe, me eab anian ngeni engame me dementia. Dorer ngeni dokita me eab eouweiy om eam.

Eke akaun me ads. Ango ougid Google Analytics bwe tsieda engame metu me peipa me animwen, me om browser e tsieda ngago soft sounds e on. Pija me om reiet ngeni Photo pairs eab upload. Taraw bita privacy notice ean bwiida.
Eab. Creative Activities e ngeni animwen ma information. Ean emaron, dorer ngeni dokita, me ian emedjensi kiy 111.

organizations.restHtml:
Aron kudo re aea

  • Mwio in aea engame ma memory care: bingo in pija me kano-dorer eat TV ian common room, me engame aipwon e tano screen bwiin kudo meikona.
  • Program in rane bwiin engame ro ketaura: tablet station me Picture pairs e oebwi ean tile auwogo, bwiin sessions me e oebwi.
  • Mwio in buk: pepa in word search ma conversation cards ian kits bwiin memory, ma bookmark website eat tablets ian mwio in buk.
  • Kudo in oebwi bwiin ro re aea engame ma memory cafés: pepa aipwon bwe wo print bwiin famili bwe re bweronga mwio.
  • Hospitals ma planners in bweronga mwio: pepa eat packet bwiin ro re aea engame, bwe e bwe nimin me e maraurau bwe re aea eat mwio me irin bed.

Nimin ang ekeow makur ean

Games meikona bwiin aenomwei ma mwaereng in bwieta. Re gonae diagnose, test, score, treat me slow dementia, ma ang dorer kudo bwe re ekeow dorer ean aron eiy. Ekeow ads, ma games meikona re gonae kiijin eta, health details me re download photos. Eiy website e aea Google Analytics bwe e aea visits; amat privacy notice e kaalolo nimin e aea. Photos me wo aea ian Photo pairs re bita ian browser.

Bwitok me ebang

Bwitok ma aoeo pija eongobwang ngago o etae. Nuwawin pija e atengame, me ogogo eng e oij me e oeb. Gentle mode ekeow timer, score me penalty. Iwi 4, 6, 8 me e 12 pija.

Iwi pija me pamli me gadjit me device me aen. App e oten pija ebang me kakarara. Eab scan library me eab keta original pija, me e oten 24 pija me collection.

Aea ma kakarara

Aea aipwon pija ngeni aea. Dorer e oaten eab keta engame bwe iat egore iy me dorer engame. Nuwawin aea e rogon.

Eaen offline

Pija me bwitok me aijuw pak pija e ngago me app. Kopii me pija eeaen offline. Iwi original me iCloud e kain internet.

Ekeow account, ekeow server me photo-sync

Kopii me pija me pamli e tsimine me app me device. Oita kopii me eab ko original. Backup me device e tsimine data me app. Aea app privacy policy, me app help e aen animwen.

faq.q: Kakarara arir o bwitok ma iy?
faq.a: Picture pairs ma aoeo pija e rogon me bwitok. Ean pija e rogon keta, aea Find the same ma aro pija. Me group, aea Picture bingo.

faq.q: Kakarara e rogon ma iPad me tarepon?
faq.a: Ehe. Kakarara me nuka e rogon ma browser me tarepon, tablet me computer, me pija e eongobwang me screen. Tablet ma stand e rogon me aro engame.

faq.q: Kakarara nanei e rogon me engame me bwiin Alzheimer’s?
faq.a: Ehe. Karow me engame me bwiin dementia, me Alzheimer’s e tsimine. Pija e atengame, ekeow ngago e kain, me ekeow timer me score, me kakarara e aea pija ngago o etae me eab kain etae ngago e tsimine.

faq.q: Kakarara nanei memory games me engame rogon?
faq.a: Ran ekakaru ena e ran matching ao ran picture, ko tauwa ouõ ni n-ekeberu ran tauwa, ao e ran kinaba ni ouõ ni test ran memory: ni Picture pairs ran picture e ran nan tibak ni ekaban kam ouõ ekan. Ran memory game ni rõr e ekeberu ngke ekan ran timer ao ran score.

faq.q: E tsimine kakarara me groups me care home?
faq.a: Ehe. Picture bingo e tsimine printable cards me caller ma screen, me Finish the saying me Conversation cards e rogon bwe iat dorer ngeni group.

reasons.photos: E ouõ version ni paper. Ekakaru ena e ekoreba ran photo kiyo, ran photo ni tei ran browser kiyo ao ouõ upload, ao website ena ouõ ni print. Ngke kam ekan ibeba ko paper, kam print ruwe copy ko ran photo kiyo ko home, ao kam matching ko table.

reasons.turns: E ouõ version ni paper ko ekakaru ena. Ngke kam ekan ran pair ko table, kam print ran picture card ko Picture pairs ao kam ekan ran turn ko ekabwe ran card kiyo.
reasons.screen: Ke tōn pepa. Ēn ekarawa ni kōnan ni skrin, ni ṅaṅ ekarawa ō ekaraŋ ō ṅuwan ṅaṅ eiñ ṅō nōnōn aduwaŋ, ma ni ekarawa ō ekaraŋ ni pirī ō wīr nē eñ ṅaṅ ekarawa ṅō ṅuwan.
reasons.wash: Ke tōn pepa. Ēn ekarawa ni pent wōtā ō pepa ō aduwaŋ ekaraŋ: ekarawa ni burasi ṅaṅ ekaraŋ ni wōtā, ō ekarawa ni kōnan ṅaṅ ekaraŋ kakāi.
reasons.sayings: Ke tōn pepa ōmata. Ēn pepa ekaraŋ ō ekarawa ōmata ni ṅō tōnōn ni ṅuwan, ma ō ekaraŋ ni "Show the ending" ni nē ṅō ṅuwan. Ṅaṅ ekaraŋ ni skrin ō kōnan ōmata, ō ekarawa ni kōnan ṅaṅ ekaraŋ ni ṅō ṅuwan ṅaṅ eiñ.
